fichas.title: Refurbishment of timber joist floor slabs
fichas.summary: Overview of traditional timber joist floors and methods of refurbishment. Existing joists may sag because they were sized empirically; the text describes strengthening joists, improving load distribution, shortening spans, and improving sound insulation. Wet rooms above timber floors need careful detailing to limit water penetration and damp damage.
